title: Be brave enough to kill the inner tyrant
summary: Real courage subdues inner ego and lets praise redeem life. Treat ego as illness, not identity.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: Real courage subdues inner ego and lets praise redeem life.
source.lifeApplication: When conflict sharpens you, aim first at the inner tyrant.

evidence.coreClaim: Real courage subdues inner ego and lets praise redeem life.
evidence.turn: Remember this: measure courage by how deeply ego is subdued.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.
